_doc: Per-bank earnings-call transcript sources. Mirrors investor_presentation_urls.json in shape, but the archive enumerates itself: the bank's index page lists every call as a '/earnings-call/q<N>-<YYYY>' slug, so only the slug is configured and scripts/update_transcripts.py discovers the quarters. Period keys are 'YYYYQn' as AlphaSpread labels the call (Turkish interim calls are cumulative: 1H=Q2, 9M=Q3, full-year=Q4).

_source.name: alphaspread
_source.note: Server-rendered HTML — transcript body and Q&A are in the raw response, no JS needed. robots.txt is 'User-agent: * / Disallow:' (all paths allowed; ChatGPT-User is the only disallowed agent). A default urllib User-Agent gets 403, so the fetcher sends a browser UA.
_source.quality: Machine transcription. Content is complete (opening through closing remarks incl. Q&A), but SPEAKER ATTRIBUTION is not: the operator's naming of Turkish analysts is often transcribed '[indiscernible]', which also leaves those turns untagged as role='analyst'. Counted per call in the indiscernible_count column — treat analyst identity as unreliable, and never read a figure off a transcript as fact (numbers are spoken aloud and land as e.g. 'TRY 51.7 billion, 5-1-0.7').

_deferred.SKBNK: Şekerbank — AlphaSpread returns 'No Earnings Calls Available'; Yahoo lists no earnings calls either. Holds no English investor call.
_deferred.QNBFB: QNB Bank — delisted from BIST; no call archive.
_deferred.ICBCT: ICBC Turkey — no earnings call and no public IR deck archive (also the one bank unseeded in investor_presentation_urls.json).
_deferred._note: These three are absences at the SOURCE, not gaps in our coverage. An empty lane for them is the correct answer, not a bug to chase.
